items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah, Narm used to play with him.

ctx.x: No, you know what he talked about. Old man Ullett used to play, uh, Violet. Oh, Violet.

That's the old Creole. Yeah, Narm used to play with him. Well? To say across the river too, Ullett, across the river. No, no, he's not. No, Ullett. Well the old man Ullett, I played with him, with, uh, in Bucktown. Yeah. With the old man Ullett. He's the old Creole man. Yeah. But he had, and this cantrip used to play, uh, uh, uh, ghetto.
